GE Aerospace Wins Five-Year Logistics Contract

: GE Aerospace won a five-year, $2.87B performance-based logistics contract to maintain 17 F414 engine components for F/A-18 E/F/G jets through Aug 2031; primary work in Lynn, MA and Jacksonville, FL.
